limitedAmmoTypes.name: Unlimited
limitedAmmoTypes.description: Players have unlimited ammo, carry no ammo boxes, and do not display an ammo count on the wrist.

limitedAmmoTypes.name: Limited Generic
limitedAmmoTypes.description: Players carry ammo boxes with a limited amount of ammo.
details: One box for each weapon class: Pistol, Submachine Gun, Rifles/MGs, Shotgun, and Sniper.
Mags and ammo boxes can be put on the chest of the player to consolidate the ammo.
An ammo count is displayed on the wrist.

limitedAmmoTypes.name: Limited Specific
limitedAmmoTypes.description: Players carry ammo boxes with a limited amount of ammo.
details: Mags and ammo boxes can be put on the chest of the player to consolidate the ammo.
An ammo count is displayed on the wrist.

limitedAmmoTypes.name: Custom
limitedAmmoTypes.description: Allows for full control over ammo by the map.

limitedAmmoTypes.name: Limited Special
limitedAmmoTypes.description: All weapons except special weapons are unlimited.

limitedAmmoTypes.name: Boxless
limitedAmmoTypes.description: Like Limited Generic but without boxes.
